mapper.insert: INSERT INTO h3_naver_statreport_daily (deltakey, daily_dt, report_type, success, jobid, userid) VALUES (#{deltakey}, #{daily_dt}, #{report_type}, #{success}, #{jobid}, #{userid})

INSERT INTO h3_campaign_daily_naver_convtype ( daily_advid, daily_dt, campaign_id, conv_type_code, conv_type_name, conv_cnt, conv_value ) VALUES
( #{r.daily_advid}, #{r.daily_dt}, #{r.campaign_id}, #{r.conv_type_code}, #{r.conv_type_name}, #{r.conv_cnt}, #{r.conv_value} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE conv_type_name = VALUES(conv_type_name), conv_cnt = VALUES(conv_cnt), conv_value = VALUES(conv_value), daily_update = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
